messages.subject: I&I Group | Digital transformation, country strategy and executive stakeholder leadership
messages.body:
Dear I&I Group Leadership Team,

I am reaching out because your digital transformation and enterprise technology platform aligns closely with my experience leading regulated operations, ESG and country stakeholder priorities.

I currently serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My responsibilities span government and regulatory relations, ESG, social performance, corporate coordination and executive stakeholder strategy.

I bring hands-on experience aligning ministries, regulators, communities, strategic partners and internal teams around complex investment and sustainability priorities. My recent work also includes large-scale solar and battery-storage transition support and carbon-data governance.

I would welcome consideration for Thailand or regional mandates across Corporate Affairs, Government Relations, Sustainability, Strategic Partnerships or country leadership. I have attached a I&I Group-focused executive CV.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
